milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' is an observe/locate task — the player must navigate near the iron ore cluster (centered at spawn-relative [8, 1, 8]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. The iron ore cluster spans [7-9, 0-2, 7-9] relative to spawn, so the center is [8, 1, 8]. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range on the flat field, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the iron ore, not just passing by.

Uses inventory_has because mining stone_brick_stairs with any pickaxe (including the provided wooden pickaxe) causes the block to drop itself as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 stone_brick_stairs in inventory, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over mine_block event tracking because inventory_has directly verifies the player obtained the resource.
